visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of the MUJI cha POP-UP STORE storefront in a bright, modern shopping mall. The branding is prominently displayed on a light wood-textured wall, accompanied by a vertical banner showing a refreshing green tea drink. (2) A female hand is seen interacting with a white self-service kiosk, selecting drink options from a digital interface. The surroundings are clean and well-lit with studio-style interior lighting. (3) The camera focuses on a wooden map of Taiwan on the wall, highlighting tea regions. Glass tea-making apparatus and loose-leaf tea jars are neatly arranged on wooden shelves. (4) A young woman with brown hair, wearing a denim top, is shown from the chest up, drinking from a white MUJI paper cup with a straw. Her expression is calm and appreciative. (5) The camera pans across retail shelves displaying MUJI snacks like red beans and bottled syrups, alongside household items like bowls and mirrors. (6) A final shot shows the MUJI drink cup held in front of an outdoor urban park background with green trees, followed by more shots of the indoor retail display and furniture items.
